title: CredTrack: staff certificate and right-to-work tracking for care and staffing agencies
source: Top 25 SaaS ideas for Victor (research report, Nov 2026)
summary: Staff upload certificates and right-to-work documents from their phone; AI reads the expiry dates and chases renewals, so the agency, clinic or care home is always ready for an inspection.
hook: "We had to stand a nurse down on the morning of a shift because her training certificate had expired and nobody noticed."
story:
**Priya is compliance manager at a UK care staffing agency with 120 workers.** Every worker needs valid right-to-work documents, DBS checks, training certificates and sometimes a driving licence. She keeps them in shared folders and a spreadsheet, and she chases workers by text message when something is about to expire.

Before an inspection she spends days checking every file by hand. One expired certificate can mean a worker cannot take a shift, or a client loses trust. With CredTrack, workers **upload a photo from their phone**, AI reads the **issuer and expiry date**, reminders go out automatically, and Priya can export an **inspection-ready pack per worker** in one click.
whyNow: In 2026 several funded US companies added AI credential checks for staffing firms (KarmaCheck inside Bullhorn, Asurint with Bullhorn in July 2026, Firstwork). This shows the workflow has value, but they focus on US healthcare staffing on Bullhorn, leaving small UK and EU agencies. No regulatory deadline was found.
evidence: KarmaCheck expanded its Bullhorn integration with AI credentialing automation in 2026 [HR Tech Edge]
Asurint and Bullhorn launched a healthcare-staffing credential solution in July 2026 [Asurint]
Firstwork offers credential and onboarding automation for staffing firms [BERI]

whoPays.label: Customer

whoPays.label: Buyer

solution.title: Requirement profiles
solution.text: the agency sets which documents each role needs (nurse, carer, driver).

solution.title: Phone upload
solution.text: each worker gets a magic link and uploads photos of documents; no app or login.

solution.title: AI reads the document
solution.text: OCR + AI extract name, issuer, issue date and expiry.

solution.title: Compliance matrix
solution.text: a green/amber/red grid of workers against required documents.

solution.title: Automatic reminders
solution.text: to workers and managers before anything expires.

solution.title: Inspection-ready export
solution.text: PDF and CSV pack per worker.
